finding: Status read/ordinary HSET/read is not an atomic claim. A passed final status read can be followed by another writer overwriting the shared proof slot before the first writes/publishes its own updates. The regular planner data-header fence alone does not bind that shared proof slot to the selected update version in this model. Whole planner/runtime behavior remains unverified.
requiredOwnerDeliverables: Protocol/edge owner: atomic claim keyed by realm/pending/user/nonce/start leaf, idempotent same-request hash and explicit conflicting-request result
Storage/queue owner: fenced or request-versioned proof+updates+queue publication; crash recovery cannot expose mixed versions
Isolated runtime owner: frozen source/image/config and controlled two-writer barrier tests, exact one consistent canonical end-state and fee debit, duplicate/lost-ack/crash/rotation recovery evidence
applicationBoundary: shared journal serializes cooperating executors only; a public SD-key holder can bypass that application lock; deterministic ordering and full UPS verification do not certify edge admission atomicity
